lines.text: Many learners say: People is very nice here.
Better: People are very nice here.

native.tip: Em português “gente” e “povo” são singulares, mas em inglês “people” é plural e pede “are”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “People is very nice here”. O certo é “People are very nice here”. Palavras como “gente” e “povo” são singulares em português, mas “people” é plural. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “are”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: In Portuguese “gente” and “povo” are singular, but in English “people” is plural and takes “are”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “People is very nice here”. The right way is “People are very nice here”. Words like “gente” and “povo” are singular in Portuguese, but “people” is plural. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
